title: luscombeu/cagescan pipeline parameters
description: Reconstruct 5'-anchored transcripts from paired-end CAGE (CAGEscan) reads without UMIs

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: A comma-separated file with a header row and the columns `sample,fastq_1,fastq_2`, plus an optional `group` column naming the condition each sample is a replicate of (used for sharp RECLU clusters; default: all samples are one group). Reads must be paired-end CAGE (READ1 starts at the capped 5' end). Rows with the same sample name are treated as lanes and concatenated.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

fasta.description: Path to the genome FASTA file.

gtf.description: Path to a reference annotation GTF (optional).
gtf.help_text: Used for STAR splice-junction database and to compare the reconstructed transcripts with the annotation (gffcompare). Not needed to build transcripts.

star_index.description: Path to a pre-built STAR index directory. Built from --fasta (and --gtf) if not given.

read_processing_options.title: Read processing options
read_processing_options.description: Linker, adapter, quality and rRNA filtering of the reads.

r1_5p_linker.description: Linker sequence at the 5' end of READ1 to remove (e.g. `TATAGGG` for nanoCAGE).
r1_5p_linker.help_text: The linker and anything before it in READ1 are trimmed with cutadapt (`-g LINKER`). Leave unset if READ1 already starts at the cap; check `ctss/*.softclip_5p.tsv` from a first run to see what precedes the cap.

linker_discard_untrimmed.description: Discard read pairs whose READ1 does not contain the linker.

r1_trim_front.description: Trim this many bases from the 5' end of READ1 (fastp `--trim_front1`).

r2_trim_front.description: Trim this many bases from the 5' end of READ2 (fastp `--trim_front2`).
r2_trim_front.help_text: In CAGEscan libraries the first READ2 bases come from the random primer, and primer-RNA mismatches are tolerated by the reverse transcriptase. FANTOM5 CAGEscan (Bertin et al. 2017) trimmed 6 bases for random hexamers.

skip_fastp.description: Skip adapter and quality trimming with fastp.

ribo_database_manifest.description: Text file listing rRNA FASTA files (one path per line) for SortMeRNA rRNA removal. Skipped if not set.

min_mapq.description: Minimum READ1 mapping quality for CTSS and TSS assignment (STAR: 255 = unique).

dedup.description: Mark PCR duplicates by pair position (samtools markdup) and ignore them downstream.
dedup.help_text: Without UMIs, read pairs with identical READ1 and READ2 positions are the best available proxy for PCR duplicates. Off by default because highly expressed short fragments also collide by chance.

sl_sequence.description: Spliced-leader sequence (5'->3'), for organisms with SL trans-splicing.
sl_sequence.help_text: READ1s whose soft-clipped 5' sequence ends with the SL are counted as trans-spliced; their fraction is reported per sample and per TSS cluster.

paraclu_min_cluster.description: Minimum pooled CTSS count for a paraclu TSS cluster.

tss_window.description: Extend TSS clusters by this many bases when assigning READ1s and anchoring transcripts.

tss_merge_distance.description: Merge TSS clusters on the same strand separated by at most this many bases (-1: merge only overlapping clusters).
tss_merge_distance.help_text: paraclu can split one TSS into neighbouring clusters, for example when the non-templated 5' G aligns to a genomic G for part of the reads.

sharp_tss_cluster_options.title: Sharp TSS cluster options (RECLU)
sharp_tss_cluster_options.description: Reproducible, narrow TSS clusters following RECLU (Ohmiya et al. 2014). Built in addition to the broad pooled-paraclu clusters; transcripts are built for both sets.

skip_sharp_clusters.description: Do not build sharp (RECLU) clusters; only the broad set is used.

reclu_paraclu_min.description: paraclu minValue (minimum total CTSS count) for the per-replicate cluster hierarchy.

reclu_min_tpm_per_base.description: Keep replicate clusters with at least this many tags per million per base.

reclu_score.description: Cluster score whose reproducibility IDR tests.
reclu_score.help_text: `stability` is RECLU's hierarchical stability (a cluster's paraclu stability plus that of all clusters containing it). A paraclu stability depends on the distance to the nearest stray CTSS and varies by large factors between replicates, so by default the log stabilities are summed (`log-stability`). On simulated replicates this recovered 109 of 157 TSSs versus 24 for `stability` and 78 for `tpm`, with no false clusters in any mode.

reclu_min_overlap.description: Minimum reciprocal overlap to pair clusters of two replicates.

reclu_max_idr.description: Keep paired clusters with an irreproducible discovery rate below this value.

reclu_max_length.description: Discard reproducible clusters longer than this.

reclu_min_pairs.description: Minimum number of paired clusters to fit the IDR model; with fewer, pairs are kept on overlap alone.

min_transcript_length.description: Minimum transcript length for StringTie assembly and merge.

stringtie_guide.description: Use --gtf as a StringTie guide annotation.
stringtie_guide.help_text: Off by default so that transcript 5' ends come from the CAGE data rather than the annotation.

keep_unanchored.description: Also output assembled transcripts whose 5' end is not in a TSS cluster (prefixed `U_`).

derive_transcripts.description: Derive transcripts for TSS clusters that lie inside an exon of another TSS's transcript.
derive_transcripts.help_text: StringTie cannot start a transcript inside continuously covered sequence, so e.g. a second TSS in the same first exon gets no assembled transcript. Derived transcripts start at the cluster peak and follow the structure of the enclosing transcript(s); they are marked anchored "derived" with derived_from <source>.

erna_options.title: eRNA candidate options
erna_options.description: Enhancer-RNA-like divergent pairs of TSS clusters (Andersson et al. 2014), with convergent pairs as a chance control.

find_erna.description: Report enhancer-RNA-like divergent TSS cluster pairs for each cluster set.

erna_min_reads.description: Minimum READ1s (all samples) of each TSS cluster of a pair.

erna_max_sl_fraction.description: Maximum spliced-leader fraction of each TSS cluster (SL-dominated clusters are trans-splice acceptors, not TSSs).

erna_min_distance.description: Minimum distance between the two TSS peaks.

erna_max_distance.description: Maximum distance between the two TSS peaks.

erna_distal_distance.description: Both TSS peaks must be further than this from any annotated transcript 5' end (needs --gtf).

erna_max_directionality.description: Maximum directionality |F-R|/(F+R) of a pair (Andersson et al. 2014).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
